description: After the disagreement question advances, the API design question is judged on its own topic: a leftover conflict story follows up on relevance and an API answer with no conflict vocabulary moves on

steps.answer: My teammate and I disagreed about caching, so I measured both designs, deployed the Redis layer, and reduced page latency by 30 percent.
A coworker objected to my plan in standup, we debated it for an afternoon, and I resolved the argument within two days.
I designed an idempotent REST endpoint whose payload carried a request key, and we reduced duplicate orders by 90 percent.
